  isActive            Boolean  @default(true)
  version             String   @default("1.0.0")
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())

  @@map("tools")
}

database_models.name: ExecutionPlan
database_models.definition:
model ExecutionPlan {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  objective String
  persona   String   @default("WHINK")
  riskLevel String   @default("LOW")
  status    String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETE, FAILED, CANCELLED
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  steps PlanStep[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("execution_plans")
}

database_models.name: PlanStep
database_models.definition:
model PlanStep {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  planId           String
  stepOrder        Int
  capability       String
  description      String?
  dependencies     String? // JSON array of step IDs
  status           String    @default("PENDING")
  approvalRequired Boolean   @default(false)
  result           String? // JSON
  error            String?
  startedAt        DateTime?
  completedAt      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())

  plan ExecutionPlan @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([planId, stepOrder])
  @@map("plan_steps")
}

database_models.name: Action
database_models.definition:
model Action {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId             String
  initiator          String // user | system | automation
  persona            String? // WHINK | MAMBA
  mambaMode          String? // OBSIDIAN | null
  planId             String?
  tool               String?
  action             String
  permissionClass    String   @default("A")
  confirmationMethod String? // auto | user_confirmed | delegated
  inputSummary       String?
  outputSummary      String?
  validationResult   String? // JSON
  status             String   @default("SUBMITTED") // SUBMITTED, VALIDATED, FAILED, UNVERIFIED, AWAITING_APPROVAL, DENIED
  outcome            String?
  postmortem         String?
  correlationId      String?
  latencyMs          Int?
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([correlationId])
  @@map("actions")
}

database_models.name: Permission
database_models.definition:
model Permission {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  capability String
  class      String   @default("A") // A, B, C
  granted    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, capability])
  @@map("permissions")
}

database_models.name: Delegation
database_models.definition:
model Delegation {
  id         String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  capability String
  conditions String? // JSON conditions
  permission String    @default("automatic")
  expiresAt  DateTime?
  isActive   Boolean   @default(true)
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, capability])
  @@map("delegations")
}

database_models.name: TenantConfig
database_models.definition:
model TenantConfig {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  tenantId    String   @unique // matches userId for single-tenant; org ID for multi
  productName String   @default("WHINK")
  logoUrl     String?
  accentColor String   @default("#38B6FF")
  supportUrl  String?
  privacyUrl  String?
  termsUrl    String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("tenant_config")
}

database_models.name: EvaluationScenario
database_models.definition:
model EvaluationScenario {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  category           String // memory_accuracy, persona_switching, permission_enforcement, context_retrieval
  title              String
  input              String
  expectedBehavior   String
  acceptanceCriteria String?
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())

  runs EvaluationRun[]

  @@map("evaluation_scenarios")
}

database_models.name: EvaluationRun
database_models.definition:
model EvaluationRun {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  scenarioId String
  userId     String
  result     String // PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL
  score      Float?
  details    String? // JSON
  executedAt DateTime @default(now())

  scenario EvaluationScenario @relation(fields: [scenarioId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user     User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([scenarioId])
  @@map("evaluation_runs")
}

database_models.name: CalendarEvent
database_models.definition:
model CalendarEvent {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  title       String
  description String?
  startAt     DateTime
  endAt       DateTime
  location    String?
  allDay      Boolean  @default(false)
  externalId  String? // for future Google Calendar sync
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, startAt])
  @@map("calendar_events")
}

database_models.name: Note
database_models.definition:
model Note {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  title     String   @default("Untitled")
  content   String
  tags      String? // JSON array
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@map("notes")
}

database_models.name: WorkingMemory
database_models.definition:
model WorkingMemory {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  key       String
  value     String
  expiresAt DateTime?
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, key])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("working_memory")
}

database_models.name: TaskHandoff
database_models.definition:
model TaskHandoff {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  taskId    String
  agentId   String
  userId    String
  summary   String
  approach  String
  blockers  String?
  nextSteps String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([taskId])
  @@index([agentId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("task_handoffs")
}

database_models.name: DocumentWorkspace
database_models.definition:
model DocumentWorkspace {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String   @unique
  workspaceSlug String   @unique
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  user      User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  documents Document[]

  @@map("document_workspaces")
}

database_models.name: Document
database_models.definition:
model Document {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId           String
  workspaceId      String
  anythingllmDocId String
  filename         String
  mimeType         String
  sizeBytes        Int
  sha256           String
  uploadedAt       DateTime @default(now())

  user      User              @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  workspace DocumentWorkspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, anythingllmDocId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("documents")
}

database_models.name: AgentKnowledge
database_models.definition:
model AgentKnowledge {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  agentId   String // e.g. "backend-engineer", "frontend-engineer"
  domain    String // e.g. "tool-loop", "prisma", "auth", "ui"
  taskType  String // e.g. "migration", "api-route", "component", "debug"
  lesson    String // The actual lesson — what worked, what failed, why
  outcome   String // "success" | "failure" | "partial"
  tags      String? // JSON array of keyword tags for retrieval
  accountId String?  @map("account_id") // M1: tenant isolation. null = global/curated lesson
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([agentId])
  @@index([domain])
  @@index([taskType])
  @@index([accountId])
  @@map("agent_knowledge")
}

database_models.name: ApprovalRequest
database_models.definition:
model ApprovalRequest {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  kind            String // tool_call | ear | autonomy_change | scheduled_post
  tool            String?
  params          Json?
  contentHash     String // sha256 hex of canonical {kind, tool, params}
  summary         String
  permissionClass String
  status          String    @default("PENDING") // PENDING, APPROVED, EXECUTING, EXECUTED, DENIED, EXPIRED, FAILED
  correlationId   String
  conversationId  String?
  persona         String    @default("WHINK")
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  expiresAt       DateTime
  decidedAt       DateTime?
  executedAt      DateTime?
  result          Json?

  user         User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  commsRequest CommsRequest?

  @@index([userId, status, expiresAt])
  @@map("approval_requests")
}

database_models.name: SocialConnection
database_models.definition:
model SocialConnection {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  platform        String // x | instagram | tiktok
  accessTokenEnc  String // AES-256-GCM via lib/key-encryption.ts, never plaintext
  refreshTokenEnc String?
  scopes          String    @default("")
  expiresAt       DateTime?
  platformUserId  String?
  platformHandle  String?
  status          String    @default("active") // active | expired | revoked
  consentGrantedAt DateTime?
  consentTextVersion String?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime  @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, platform])
  @@map("social_connections")
}

database_models.name: OAuthState
database_models.definition:
model OAuthState {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  platform        String
  stateHash       String    @unique // sha256 hex of the state value; the state itself is never stored
  codeVerifierEnc String // PKCE verifier, encrypted
  redirectUri     String
  consentGrantedAt DateTime?
  consentTextVersion String?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  expiresAt       DateTime
  usedAt          DateTime?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, platform])
  @@map("oauth_states")
}

database_models.name: ScheduledPost
database_models.definition:
model ScheduledPost {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId         String
  approvalId     String
  platform       String
  // Platform account id the post was approved for; a send is refused if the connection now differs.
  platformUserId String?
  tool           String
  args           Json
  contentHash    String // sha256 of canonical {tool, args} as approved
  sendAt         DateTime
  status         String    @default("scheduled") // scheduled | sending | sent | failed | cancelled
  error          String?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt
  sentAt         DateTime?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([approvalId])
  @@index([status, sendAt])
  @@index([userId, status])
  @@map("scheduled_posts")
}

database_models.name: NotificationPreference
database_models.definition:
model NotificationPreference {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  userId   String
  channel  String  // EMAIL | WHATSAPP | SMS | TELEGRAM | PHONE_CALL
  enabled  Boolean @default(false)
  address  String? // email, phone E.164, or Telegram chat ID
  schedule String  @default("DAILY") // DAILY | IMMEDIATE | WEEKLY
  time     String  @default("08:00") // HH:MM in user's local time
  timeZone String  @default("America/Edmonton")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, channel])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("notification_preferences")
}

database_models.name: BoardMeeting
database_models.definition:
model BoardMeeting {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  title        String
  scheduledFor DateTime
  agenda       String[]
  attendees    String[]
  status       String    @default("SCHEDULED") // SCHEDULED | HELD | CANCELLED
  minutes      String?
  minutesAt    DateTime?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, scheduledFor])
  @@map("board_meetings")
}

database_models.name: ConnectorInstall
database_models.definition:
model ConnectorInstall {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  connectorId String
  enabled     Boolean  @default(true)
  config      Json?
  installedAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, connectorId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("connector_installs")
}

database_models.name: UsageEvent
database_models.definition:
model UsageEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  provider   String
  model      String
  tokensIn   Int      @default(0)
  tokensOut  Int      @default(0)
  costMicros Int      @default(0)
  kind       String   @default("chat") // chat | tool_loop | embed | other
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@map("usage_events")
}

database_models.name: Contact
database_models.definition:
model Contact {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  name      String
  email     String?
  phone     String? // E.164
  company   String?
  tags      String[]
  source    String   @default("manual") // manual | vcard | google
  notes     String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user          User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  commsRequests CommsRequest[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([userId, phone])
  @@index([userId, email])
  @@map("contacts")
}

database_models.name: CommsRequest
database_models.definition:
model CommsRequest {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  contactId  String
  approvalId String   @unique
  kind       String // message | call
  channel    String // SMS | WHATSAPP | TELEGRAM | EMAIL | PHONE_CALL
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user     User            @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  contact  Contact         @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  approval ApprovalRequest @relation(fields: [approvalId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, contactId])
  @@map("comms_requests")
}

database_models.name: ChangeRequest
database_models.definition:
model ChangeRequest {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  title             String
  body              String
  status            String   @default("DRAFT") // DRAFT | REFINED | AWAITING_APPROVAL | SENT | IN_PROGRESS | PR_OPENED | MERGED | REJECTED | FAILED
  spec              Json?
  risk              String?
  approvalId        String?
  githubIssueUrl    String?
  githubIssueNumber Int?
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, status])
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@map("change_requests")
}

database_models.name: Contract
database_models.definition:
model Contract {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  title        String
  counterparty String
  subsidiary   String?
  projectId    String?
  valueAmount  Decimal?  @db.Decimal(14, 2)
  currency     String    @default("CAD")
  status       String    @default("DRAFT") // DRAFT | ACTIVE | COMPLETED | TERMINATED
  startDate    DateTime?
  endDate      DateTime?
  renewalDate  DateTime?
  notes        String?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt

  user    User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  project Project? @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([userId, status])
  @@index([userId, subsidiary])
  @@index([userId, projectId])
  @@index([userId, createdAt, id])
  @@map("contracts")
}

database_models.name: SkillSubmission
database_models.definition:
model SkillSubmission {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  name        String
  filename    String
  sha256      String
  sizeBytes   Int
  status      String   @default("QUEUED") // QUEUED | SCANNING | REJECTED_SECURITY | ASSESSING | ACCEPTED | REJECTED_VALUE | WAITING_MODEL | FAILED
  content     String // raw upload, encrypted at rest when ENCRYPTION_KEY is configured ("enc:" prefix), else "raw:"
  scanReport  Json?
  committee   Json?
  decision    String?
  reason      String?
  memoryIds   String[]
  attempts    Int      @default(0)
  leaseOwner  String?
  leaseUntil  DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, sha256])
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status, updatedAt])
  @@map("skill_submissions")
}

database_models.name: PasskeyCredential
database_models.definition:
model PasskeyCredential {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  credentialId String    @unique
  publicKey    Bytes
  counter      BigInt    @default(0)
  transports   String[]
  deviceName   String
  backedUp     Boolean   @default(false)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  lastUsedAt   DateTime?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("passkey_credentials")
}

database_models.name: PasskeyChallenge
database_models.definition:
model PasskeyChallenge {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String?
  challenge String
  purpose   String
  remember  Boolean   @default(false)
  clientKey String?
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  user User? @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@index([clientKey, purpose])
  @@map("passkey_challenges")
}

database_models.name: AgentJob
database_models.definition:
model AgentJob {
  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
  jobKey              String
  userId              String
  nextRunAt           DateTime
  lastRunAt           DateTime?
  lastStatus          String? // OK | FAILED | SKIPPED | TIMEOUT
  lastError           String? // short reason code, never content
  leaseUntil          DateTime?
  leaseOwner          String?
  runs                Int       @default(0)
  consecutiveFailures Int       @default(0)
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([jobKey, userId])
  @@index([nextRunAt])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("agent_jobs")
}

database_models.name: AgentHeartbeat
database_models.definition:
model AgentHeartbeat {
  workerId  String   @id
  startedAt DateTime
  lastSeenAt DateTime
  version   String

  @@map("agent_heartbeats")
}

database_models.name: NewsSeen
database_models.definition:
model NewsSeen {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  linkHash  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, linkHash])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("news_seen")
}

database_models.name: Recommendation
database_models.definition:
model Recommendation {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  source      String // agent name
  kind        String
  title       String
  body        String
  link        String?
  severity    String    @default("info") // info | warning | critical
  dedupeKey   String?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  dismissedAt DateTime?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, dedupeKey])
  @@index([userId, dismissedAt, createdAt])
  @@map("recommendations")
}

database_models.name: SwarmRun
database_models.definition:
model SwarmRun {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  projectId       String?
  subsidiary      String?
  title           String
  initiative      String // untrusted user text, always wrapped before model use
  status          String    @default("PLANNED") // PLANNED | RUNNING | FINALIZING | DONE | FAILED | CANCELLED
  minAgents       Int
  agentCount      Int
  estimate        Json
  tokenCap        Int
  tokensUsed      Int       @default(0)
  cancelRequested Boolean   @default(false)
  stopReason      String?
  result          String?
  startedAt       DateTime?
  finishedAt      DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime  @updatedAt

  user      User            @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tasks     SwarmTask[]
  claims    SwarmClaim[]
  learnings SwarmLearning[]

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@map("swarm_runs")
}

database_models.name: SwarmTask
database_models.definition:
model SwarmTask {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  runId          String
  userId         String
  lane           String // exclusive scope key
  role           String // lead | integrator | redteam | reviewer | worker
  agentId        String // real org-kit agent_id
  fit            String // matched | generalist
  title          String
  objective      String
  deliverable    String
  requiredSkills String[]
  covers         String[] // lanes this task reviews, challenges or integrates
  dependsOn      String[] // lanes
  estimatedCalls Int       @default(1)
  status         String    @default("PENDING") // PENDING | RUNNING | DONE | FAILED | SKIPPED
  attempts       Int       @default(0)
  output         Json?
  error          String?
  tokensIn       Int       @default(0)
  tokensOut      Int       @default(0)
  claimOwner     String? // engine instance holding the lane claim; every write after acquire checks it
  startedAt      DateTime?
  heartbeatAt    DateTime?
  finishedAt     DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())

  run SwarmRun @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([runId, lane])
  @@index([runId, status])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("swarm_tasks")
}

database_models.name: SwarmClaim
database_models.definition:
model SwarmClaim {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  runId     String
  userId    String
  lane      String
  taskId    String
  owner     String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  run SwarmRun @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([runId, lane])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("swarm_claims")
}

database_models.name: SwarmLearning
database_models.definition:
model SwarmLearning {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  runId      String
  userId     String
  agentId    String
  lane       String
  text       String
  sha256     String
  confidence Float    @default(0.5)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  run SwarmRun @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([runId, sha256])
  @@index([runId, createdAt])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("swarm_learnings")
}

database_models.name: RateLimitBucket
database_models.definition:
model RateLimitBucket {
  key         String
  windowStart DateTime
  count       Int      @default(0)

  @@id([key, windowStart])
  @@index([windowStart])
  @@map("rate_limit_buckets")
}

database_models.name: PasswordResetToken
database_models.definition:
model PasswordResetToken {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  tokenHash String    @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, usedAt])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@map("password_reset_tokens")
}

governance_documents.content:
version: '1.0'
principles:
  provider_independence: WHINK owns the organization; AI providers are replaceable
    execution engines.
  dormant_by_default: true
  minimum_competent_team: true
  human_pre_execution_approval_required:
  - team_size
  - schedule
  - estimated_budget
  material_change_requires_reapproval:
  - team_size
  - schedule
  - scope
  - budget
  - paid_tools
  - external_resources
  reuse_before_creation:
  - search
  - reuse
  - extend
  - retrain
  - temporary_worker
  - create_last
  least_privilege: true
  human_final_authority: true
agent_states:
- dormant
- consulted
- active
- lead
- reviewer
- suspended
- retired
new_agent_creation:
  requires_company_wide_scan: true
  must_scan:
  - active
  - dormant
  - underutilized
  - suspended_when_appropriate
  - cross_department
  - cross_directorate
  human_approval_required: true
  must_record_rationale: true

version: '2.0'
entry_personas:
  primary: WHINK
  adversarial_review: MAMBA
principles:
- route_to_smallest_competent_team
- reuse_existing_agents_before_any_creation
- all_agents_dormant_by_default
- human_approval_before_execution
- least_privilege
- provider_neutral_core
routing_stages:
- classify_task_domain
- identify_directorate
- identify_department
- scan_existing_agents_company_wide
- score_agents_by_skill_overlap_and_scope
- select_smallest_competent_team
- estimate_schedule
- estimate_budget_using_provider_adapter_rates
- prepare_execution_authorization_request
- wait_for_human_approval
- activate_approved_agents_only
- execute_and_review
- consolidate_to_whink
- return_to_human
- store_validated_lessons_only
agent_scoring:
  required_skill_overlap: 0.5
  weights:
    required_skill_match: 0.45
    department_match: 0.2
    directorate_match: 0.1
    dormant_availability: 0.1
    cost_efficiency: 0.1
    review_coverage: 0.05
  penalties:
    scope_conflict: -0.3
    permission_gap: -0.5
    active_overload: -0.2
approval_gate:
  required_before_execution: true
  required_fields:
  - objective
  - lead_agent
  - supporting_agents
  - team_size
  - schedule
  - milestones
  - estimated_budget
  - assumptions
  - risks
new_agent_policy:
  creation_allowed_only_after:
  - company_wide_registry_scan
  - reuse_evaluation
  - retraining_evaluation
  - temporary_worker_evaluation
  - human_approval
